subject: social_science

concepts.title: Yield Calculation
concepts.definition: Yield is the total quantity of a specific crop harvested from a defined unit of land area during one growing season.
concepts.key_idea: Measuring agricultural productivity per unit of land.
question_patterns: what is the yield if production is ... and land is ...
find the crop yield for a field of ... hectares
how much grain is produced per hectare
determine the yield given total output of ... kg

solution_steps.action: divide total production by land area
solution_steps.explain: yield is defined as output per unit area

concepts.title: Loan Interest Calculation
concepts.definition: The additional cost paid by a borrower to a lender for the use of money over a specified period, expressed as a percentage of the principal.
concepts.key_idea: Cost of borrowing capital for agricultural inputs.
question_patterns: calculate the interest on a loan of ... at ... percent
what is the total interest for ... months
find the interest amount for a principal of ...
how much extra must the farmer pay for a loan of ...
compute the interest cost at ... rate for ... months

solution_steps.explain: interest is principal times rate times time fraction

concepts.title: Surplus Calculation
concepts.definition: The quantity of agricultural produce remaining after the farmer has set aside enough for their own family's consumption needs.
concepts.key_idea: Determining the amount available for market sale.
question_patterns: find the surplus wheat available for sale
calculate the surplus if production is ... and consumption is ...
what is the remaining grain after family use
determine the market surplus from a total of ...
how much surplus is generated if ... is produced

solution_steps.explain: surplus is the leftover after meeting family needs

worked_examples.question_pattern: calculate the yield if production is {total_production} kg and land is {land_area} hectares
find interest for principal {principal} at rate {rate} percent for {time} months
